verdict.rationale: doola documents an annual-report flow where you can read what a state asks for and charges before putting the report on file, with submit and confirm as separate calls so cost is visible before committing (doola-docs-11, doola-docs-12). Fee and state lookups are exposed in the API reference (doola-docs-6), the compliance calendar lists the recurring obligations doola tracks (doola-docs-10), and the public site gives a starting price of $297/year plus state fees (doola-docs-17). Missing for 10: an explicit published list of which states and filing types are covered, doola's own service fee for annual-report filing specifically (the $297 figure is a general package price), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
